Nitish Setu: PM modi ki bihar ko bari saugat, nitish setu ka hoga udghatan! | PM Modi | Nitish Kumar
Bihar ko pradhanmantri narendr modi kal karoron ki saugat denevale hain....shanivar se nitish setu aam janta ko supurd kar diya jayega...pradhanmantri ke daure ko lekar taiyariyan antim daur men hai... suraksha se lekar piem ke har karyakram ki monitring khud mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri kar rahe hain...chunki bihar men bani endie ki sarkar ke ek sal bhi pure ho rahe hain, aise men bijepi ne pradhanmantri ke daure ko mega ivent banane ki bari taiyari kar rakhi hai.
